blocks.text_en: The E2E_P02Check() function shall • re-initialize SyncCounter with SyncCounterInit; and • set Status to E2E_P02ST A TUS_SYNC; if the following conditions are true: • the calculated DeltaCounter is within the parameters of 1 and MaxDeltaCounter (i.e. 1 =/< DeltaCounter =/< MaxDeltaCounter); and • the value of the NoNewOrRepeatedDataCounter exceeds MaxNoNewOrRe- peatedData. (i.e. State NoNewOrRepeatedDataCounter > Config MaxNoNewOr- RepeatedData)
